summary: Constructs and throws a std::out_of_range exception carrying the message "invalid string position". Registers an SEH handler frame, copies a one-byte buffer marker and releases the prior stack buffer reference, then writes the message with its length into the reused buffer. After initializing the exception object through the exception-init handler, it sets the out_of_range vtable and calls the C++ throw entry with the out_of_range type info. The trailing destructor call is the decoded SEH unwind epilogue, never reached because the throw does not return.

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit registers the stack exception-handler frame for this function, linked to the landing pad global.
Copy one byte from the caller frame slot into the buffer marker slot before reusing the buffer.
ReferenceCountDecrementWithConditionalFree releases the previous reference held by the stack buffer slot.
Compute the length of the message with Strlen, then BufferWriteWithNullTerminate copies "invalid string position" into the buffer including its terminator.
Zero the exception object field used to track ownership before construction.
CExceptionInitHandler_ada3 constructs the exception object, building the logic_error base with the message.
Install the std::out_of_range vtable into the exception object.
CxxThrowException8 raises the exception with the std::out_of_range type info, which never returns.
Trailing ExceptionObjectDestructorWithSEH is the decoded SEH unwind epilogue; unreachable after the non-returning throw.

unresolved: The caller frame slots at a1-32/a1-13 are a small inlined buffer; their exact field layout is not recoverable from this function alone.
ExceptionObjectDestructorWithSEH is the SEH epilogue rendered as a return value, not a genuine program-logic return.
ReferenceCountDecrementWithConditionalFree operating on a stack byte slot suggests a small-buffer/string implementation detail whose type is unknown.
